name: DDAMFN (Dual-Direction Attention Mixed Feature Network)
authors_or_creators: Saining Zhang, Yuhang Zhang, Ye Liu, Heng Su (and collaborators); MDPI Electronics 2023. Affiliations include Beijing institutions (Beijing Jiaotong University / Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications collaborators).
backbone: MixedFeatureNet (MFN) — a MobileFaceNet-inspired lightweight backbone with mixed depthwise/pointwise feature blocks
accuracy_fer2013: Not officially reported in the canonical paper [uncertain]
pretrained_weights_available: yes — pretrained weights for RAF-DB / AffectNet / FERPlus released via the official GitHub repository
inference_fps_or_latency: Lightweight design suitable for real-time inference; specific FPS/latency numbers not explicitly reported in the paper [uncertain]
hardware_requirements: Training: single consumer GPU (e.g., NVIDIA RTX series) sufficient given the small parameter count; Inference: runs on CPU or low-end GPU [uncertain]
loss_function: Combination of Cross-Entropy classification loss with an Attention Loss (att_loss) that encourages diversity/orthogonality among the multi-head dual-direction attention maps
training_data_used: RAF-DB, AffectNet (7-class and 8-class), FERPlus — trained separately per benchmark
pretraining_strategy: face-recognition-pretrain — MFN backbone is pretrained on a large face recognition corpus (MS-Celeb-1M / refined face dataset) before fine-tuning on FER datasets
pretraining_corpus: MS-Celeb-1M (face recognition pretraining for MFN backbone) [uncertain]
dynamic_fer_metrics: Not applicable — DDAMFN is a static-image FER model and does not report DFEW/FERV39k/MAFW results
cross_dataset_generalization: Not extensively reported in the canonical paper; some follow-up works have evaluated DDAMFN under cross-dataset settings [uncertain]
robustness: Not explicitly evaluated on Occlusion-RAF-DB / Pose-RAF-DB in the original paper [uncertain]
explainability: Yes — the dual-direction attention maps (horizontal and vertical attention) can be visualized as attention heatmaps, providing interpretability
deployment_target: edge / mobile — designed as a lightweight FER model suitable for resource-constrained deployment
